verdict.rationale: Rive documents building interactive experiences that respond to user input, scrolling and application state, scenes that update automatically when bound data changes, and scripting for custom behaviors. Together these amount to event-driven rules inside Rive content, but nothing documents a rule or automation system for workflows or editor events. Missing for 10: an explicit event→action rule definition model (e.g., state machine listeners/events documented in depth), workflow-level automation triggered by editor or file events, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Build interactive experiences that respond to user input, screen size, scrolling, and application state.
When data changes, your scene updates automatically.
Use scripting to create custom interactions, procedural animation, and behaviors that go beyond the built-in tools.
